blocks.html: Use Group X consists of uses engaged in the mechanical, physical, or chemical transformation of materials into new goods. The provisions regulating uses classified in this Use Group are set forth as follows:
blocks.plainText: Use Group X consists of uses engaged in the mechanical, physical, or chemical transformation of materials into new goods. The provisions regulating uses classified in this Use Group are set forth as follows:

blocks.html:
1. Section 32-201 (Use Group X – general use allowances) which includes the compilation of uses in the Use Group table;
  2. Section 32-202 (Use Group X – uses subject to size limitations) for size restrictions that apply to certain uses, as denoted with an “S” in the Use Group table; 
  3. Section 32-203 (Use Group X – uses subject to additional conditions) for additional conditions that apply to certain uses, as denoted with a “P” in the Use Group table; and
  4. Section 32-204 (Use Group X – additional provisions for parking requirement category) for uses with more than one parking requirement category or other applicable parking provisions, as denoted with “*” in the Use Group table.
blocks.plainText: Section 32-201 (Use Group X – general use allowances) which includes the compilation of uses in the Use Group table; Section 32-202 (Use Group X – uses subject to size limitations) for size restrictions that apply to certain uses, as denoted with an “S” in the Use Group table; Section 32-203 (Use Group X – uses subject to additional conditions) for additional conditions that apply to certain uses, as denoted with a “P” in the Use Group table; and Section 32-204 (Use Group X – additional provisions for parking requirement category) for uses with more than one parking requirement category or other applicable parking provisions, as denoted with “*” in the Use Group table.

blocks.html: The provisions of Sections 32-202 and 32-203, except as otherwise specified in such Sections, may be modified by special permit of the Board of Standards and Appeals, in accordance with Section 73-211 (Production uses), or by special permit of the City Planning Commission, in accordance with Section 74-211 (Production uses).

amendmentHistory.projectName: City of Yes for Economic Opportunity
amendmentHistory.notes: Reorganized use provisions into new use group structure in Sections 32-11 through 32-20; relocated hotel provisions from Section 32-02 to Section 32-153 and health and fitness establishment provisions from Section 32-413 to Section 32-163; incorporated special permit references from Section 32-30 into use group provisions
amendmentHistory.description: An amendment modifying multiple Sections to support economic growth and resiliency by providing businesses with additional zoning flexibility to locate and expand
